actors.threat_actor: APT44 (Sandworm, Voodoo Bear, Seashell Blizzard, Iron Viking, Telebots)
actors.notes: Russia-nexus (GRU Unit 74455). Formally designated APT44 by Mandiant in April 2024. Champion Malware use (#7 - wipers: NotPetya, HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, CrashOverride/Industroyer, DARKCRYSTALRAT, trojanized software). High Exploiting Server (#2 - exploitation of unpatched internet-facing appliances, OT/ICS systems). High Abuse of Functions (#1 - Living-off-the-Land techniques, OT/SCADA manipulation for physical impact). High Identity Theft (#4 - credential phishing, lateral movement via stolen creds). High Social Engineering (#9 - spear phishing, watering holes, trojanized software via forums). High Flooding Attack (#6 - DDoS as part of combined operations). High Supply Chain (#10 - trojanized software distribution, compromised update channels). Medium MitM (#5 - network interception in targeted environments). Medium Physical (#8 - OT attacks causing real-world physical impact: power outages, industrial disruption). Targets critical infrastructure (energy, water, transportation), defense, media, civil society. Primarily Ukraine and NATO-aligned nations. Notable incidents: Ukraine power grid 2015/2016, NotPetya 2017, Olympic Destroyer 2018, ongoing Ukraine war operations.
sources: SANS ICS 'Analysis of the Cyber Attack on the Ukrainian Power Grid' (2016)

actors.notes: North Korea-nexus (DPRK military intelligence). Formally designated APT45 by Mandiant in July 2024. Champion Malware use (#7 - Dtrack/Valefor/Preft backdoor, SHATTEREDGLASS wiper, Maui ransomware, custom families with unique encoding and code reuse). High Exploiting Server (#2 - targeting internet-facing applications, particularly in healthcare and energy sectors). High Social Engineering (#9 - spear phishing with military/defense lures). Medium Client Exploits (#3 - leveraging public exploits). Medium Identity Theft (#4 - credential expansion for lateral movement). Medium Abuse of Functions (#1 - post-compromise data staging and exfiltration). Medium Supply Chain (#10 - Kudankulam NPP India 2019 intrusion via contractor networks). Active since ~2009, expanded from pure espionage to financially-motivated ransomware. Targets defense industries, government agencies, healthcare, energy, financial institutions, and nuclear facilities.
sources: Mandiant 'APT45: North Korea's Digital Military Machine' (July 2024)
